title: Data Engineering Mastery Roadmap
subtitle: Complete Zero-to-Hero Industry Curriculum from Fundamentals to Cloud, Streaming & DataOps

stages.title: Programming & Linux Fundamentals
stages.subtitle: Python, Advanced SQL, Bash/Linux, and Git for Data Engineers
stages.description: Establish software engineering rigor for data systems. Master modern Python for data engineering (typing, OOP, generators, pandas/polars), SQL mastery (window functions, CTEs, explain plans), Linux command-line data processing, and Git collaboration.
learningOutcomes: Write production-grade, maintainable Python using type annotations, OOP, generators, and data handling libraries
Write complex SQL queries utilizing window functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, LEAD, LAG) and Common Table Expressions (CTEs)
Operate comfortably inside Linux environments using pipes, grep, awk, sed, and schedule tasks via cron
Implement version control best practices, branch management, pull requests, and automated Git workflows for data repositories

stages.title: Data Modeling, Warehouses & Storage
stages.subtitle: Kimball Dimensional Modeling, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, and AWS Redshift
stages.description: Understand how analytical data is structured and stored at enterprise scale. Master dimensional modeling (Kimball facts, dimensions, SCDs), compare OLTP vs OLAP architectures, and explore modern cloud data warehouses: Snowflake, BigQuery, and Redshift.
learningOutcomes: Architect Kimball dimensional models using Star and Snowflake schemas with conformed dimensions
Implement Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 1, 2, 3, 4, 6) for historical tracking
Master Snowflake's unique multi-cluster shared data architecture, micro-partitioning, and virtual warehouses
Optimize BigQuery using partitioning, clustering, and slot management for petabyte-scale queries
Configure Amazon Redshift distribution styles (KEY, EVEN, ALL) and sort keys for MPP query execution

stages.title: Data Lakes, Lakehouses & Modern Table Formats
stages.subtitle: Object Storage, Parquet, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, and Apache Hudi
stages.description: Transition from traditional data warehouses to modern open lakehouse architectures. Learn columnar file formats, ACID transactions over object storage (S3/GCS/ADLS), and the battle of open table formats: Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, and Apache Hudi.
learningOutcomes: Explain the technical distinctions between Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, and Lakehouses
Understand columnar storage mechanics: Parquet row groups, columnar chunking, dictionary encoding, and Snappy compression
Architect Lakehouse systems with Apache Iceberg: metadata trees, manifest lists, hidden partitioning, and schema evolution
Deploy Delta Lake with ACID transaction logs (_delta_log), OPTIMIZE, Z-ORDER, and VACUUM operations
Differentiate Copy-on-Write (CoW) vs Merge-on-Read (MoR) in Apache Hudi for high-frequency mutation workloads

modules.title: Data Lake Fundamentals & Columnar Storage
modules.summary: The shift to Lakehouse, Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), and file format comparisons.

videos.title: Data Engineering Course for Beginners
keyTakeaways: End-to-end data pipeline lifecycle and modern data stack overview

modules.title: Apache Iceberg Open Table Format

keyTakeaways: Why Hive table formats failed at scale (O(N) file listing bottlenecks)
Iceberg metadata tree: Iceberg Catalog -> Table Metadata -> Manifest List -> Manifest Files -> Data Files
ACID transactions, atomic commits via catalog compare-and-swap (CAS)

videos.title: Apache Iceberg 101 - 2026 Edition
keyTakeaways: Hidden partitioning: partition evolution without rewriting data tables
Full schema evolution (add, drop, rename, reorder columns safely)
Time travel queries and rollback capabilities

modules.title: Delta Lake & UniForm

videos.title: Deep-Dive into Delta Lake
keyTakeaways: The _delta_log JSON commit protocol and checkpointing (.checkpoint.parquet)
Concurrency control: Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) and conflict resolution
ACID guarantees for concurrent batch and streaming writes

videos.title: Deep Dive into Delta Lake and UniForm on Databricks
keyTakeaways: Universal Format (UniForm): reading Delta tables as Iceberg or Hudi without copying data

videos.title: Lakehouse with Delta Lake Deep Dive Training
keyTakeaways: OPTIMIZE command and small file compaction
Multi-dimensional clustering with Z-ORDER BY

keyTakeaways: Hudi Timeline and instant states (Requested, Inflight, Completed)

stages.title: Distributed Computing & Batch Processing
stages.subtitle: Distributed Systems, Apache Spark, PySpark, and Performance Tuning
stages.description: Master big data computation across clusters. Learn the internal workings of distributed computing (MapReduce, DAG schedulers, shuffles), master Apache Spark & PySpark (Core, DataFrames, Spark SQL), and perform deep performance tuning (Catalyst, Tungsten, memory management, data skew resolution).
learningOutcomes: Explain cluster architecture: Driver, Cluster Manager (YARN, K8s, Standalone), and Worker/Executor nodes
Write production PySpark data pipelines using DataFrame API, transformations vs actions, and Spark SQL
Understand Spark Catalyst Optimizer phases: Analysis, Logical Plan, Physical Plan, and Code Generation
Diagnose and eliminate Spark bottlenecks: shuffle spills (memory to disk), GC pauses, and unbalanced partitions
Resolve severe data skew using salting techniques, broadcast hash joins, and Adaptive Query Execution (AQE)

modules.title: Distributed Architecture & MapReduce Fundamentals

stages.title: Data Orchestration & Pipelines
stages.subtitle: Workflow Management, Apache Airflow, Dagster, and Prefect
stages.description: Design resilient, production-ready data pipelines. Master workflow orchestration fundamentals (DAGs, idempotency, backfilling, retries, SLAs), dive deep into Apache Airflow 2.x (TaskFlow API, sensors, executors), and discover modern orchestration tools: Dagster (Software-Defined Assets) and Prefect.
learningOutcomes: Structure production workflows as Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) upholding strict idempotency and atomic task design
Master Apache Airflow 2.x: TaskFlow API (@dag, @task), XComs, dynamic task mapping, and Sensors
Configure Airflow deployment architectures: CeleryExecutor vs KubernetesExecutor with Postgres metadata store
Build software-defined asset lineage and partition-aware data pipelines with Dagster
Orchestrate modern Python workflows using Prefect flows, tasks, deployments, and work pools

stages.title: Real-Time Streaming & Message Queues
stages.subtitle: Event Streaming, Apache Kafka, Kafka Streams, and Apache Flink
stages.description: Unlock real-time streaming data architectures. Understand the difference between batch and event-driven architectures, master Apache Kafka (brokers, partitions, consumer groups, Schema Registry, KRaft mode), and implement stateful stream processing with Apache Flink.
learningOutcomes: Architect event-driven systems using distributed commit logs, pub/sub topologies, and consumer groups
Master Apache Kafka: topic partitioning, producer acks, consumer offset management, and KRaft consensus
Enforce strict schema compatibility (Avro/Protobuf) using Confluent Schema Registry
Build stateful stream processors with Apache Flink: watermarks, windowing (tumbling, sliding, session)
Guarantee Exactly-Once Processing (E2E EOS) using Flink's Chandy-Lamport checkpointing and 2-phase commit

keyTakeaways: JobManager, TaskManager, and Task Slots architecture

stages.subtitle: dbt (Data Build Tool), Great Expectations, Soda, and Data Testing

Write modular Jinja templates, dynamic macros, packages, and custom schema tests in dbt
Implement high-performance incremental models using merge, delete+insert, and append strategies
Create automated data quality suites using Great Expectations (GX Checkpoints and Data Docs)
Integrate proactive data contract testing and monitoring within CI/CD and Airflow DAGs

stages.title: Cloud, Infrastructure as Code & DataOps
stages.subtitle: AWS/GCP Stacks, Terraform, Docker, CI/CD, and Data Governance
stages.description: Graduate to production enterprise data engineering. Build end-to-end cloud data platforms (AWS S3, Glue, Athena; GCP BigQuery), provision immutable infrastructure using Terraform, containerize data systems with Docker, implement CI/CD for data pipelines, and enforce Data Governance with DataHub.
learningOutcomes: Build complete cloud data architectures on AWS (S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda) and GCP (GCS, BigQuery, Looker Studio)
Declare data infrastructure as code with Terraform: managing S3 buckets, IAM roles, BigQuery datasets, and Snowflake databases
Containerize data applications with Docker: multi-stage builds, environment isolation, and multi-service Docker Compose
Implement CI/CD for data pipelines with GitHub Actions: automated unit tests (pytest), SQL linting (sqlfluff), and dbt slim CI
Establish enterprise Data Governance and Data Lineage using DataHub to trace column-level upstream/downstream impacts
